objectives: Describe the death of Sarah and the purchase of the cave of Machpelah.
takeaways: Sarah lived 127 years and died in Hebron in the land of Canaan.
Abraham insisted on paying 400 shekels of silver, and the field and cave of Machpelah were made sure to him for a burying place.
